Trigger.TriggerText:
if :staff_off_day.from_time is not null and :staff_off_day.to_time is not null then
 :paid_hrs := (:staff_off_day.to_time - :staff_off_day.from_time) * 24 * 60;
 :paid_hrs := lpad(trunc(:paid_hrs/60), 2, '0')||
 ':'||lpad(mod(:paid_hrs,60),2,'0');

 :staff_off_day.from_time)*24*60;

 ':'||lpad(mod(:staff_off_day.paid_hrs,60),2,'0');

ProgramUnit.Name: DRIVE_INFORMATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE drive_information IS
d_date date;
found varchar2(1) := 'N';
piggy_flag varchar2(1) := 'N' ;
piggy_actual_bod date;
piggy_actual_eod date;
work_assgn_cnt number := 0;
nonwork_assgn_cnt number:=0;
v_tot_disp_hrs number;
v_tot_non_work number;
v_diff number;
BEGIN
 go_block('staff_off_day');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 go_block('non_job_blk');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 GO_BLOCK('schedules_blk');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 FIRST_RECORD;
 d_date := to_date(:control_blk.from_date,'MM-DD-RR'); 

LOOP ---Start LOOP for dates between from date AND to date
 IF d_date > to_date(:control_blk.to_date,'MM-DD-RR') THEN
 exit;
 ELSE
 declare
 cursor C1 is
 SELECT dr.drive_date dr_date, to_char(dr.drive_date,'Dy') week_day,
 ssd.drive_id drive, ssd.job_code, ssd.special_job_code , 
 ssd.actual_bod, ssd.actual_eod, ssd.comments
 from drives dr, staff_schedule_details ssd
 where ssd.staff_no = :control_blk.staff_no 
 and ssd.schedule_id = :control_blk.schedule_id 
 and ssd.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and dr.drive_id = ssd.drive_id 
 and dr.chapter_id = ssd.chapter_id 
 and dr.drive_date = d_date
 UNION
 SELECT sod.unavail_date dr_date, to_char(sod.unavail_date,'Dy') week_day,
 sod.reason drive, ' ' job_code, ' ' special_job_code , 
 sod.from_time actual_bod, sod.to_time actual_eod, sod.comments
 from staff_off_day sod
 where sod.staff_no = :control_blk.staff_no 
 and sod.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and sod.unavail_date = d_date
 ORDER BY 6, 7;
 BEGIN
 found := 'N' ; 
 FOR c1rec IN c1 LOOP --Start LOOP for DRIVES on particular date
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.drive_date := c1rec.dr_date;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.week_day := c1rec.week_day;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.drive_id := c1rec.drive ;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.comments := c1rec.comments ;

 if (c1rec.special_job_code = 'VDRVR') then
 :schedules_blk.driver_typ := 'Van';
 elsif (c1rec.special_job_code = 'CDRVR') then
 :schedules_blk.driver_typ := 'Coach';
 else
 :schedules_blk.driver_typ := c1rec.special_job_code ;
 end if;

 :SCHEDULES_BLK.job_cd := c1rec.job_code;

 IF substr(c1rec.drive,1,3) = 'DRV' THEN
 check_piggy_drive (c1rec.drive,piggy_flag, piggy_actual_bod, piggy_actual_eod);
 IF piggy_flag = 'Y' THEN
 IF c1rec.actual_bod <= piggy_actual_bod THEN
 IF piggy_actual_bod <= c1rec.actual_bod THEN
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := piggy_actual_bod;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := c1rec.actual_bod;
 END IF;
 IF piggy_actual_eod >= c1rec.actual_eod THEN
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := piggy_actual_eod;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := c1rec.actual_eod;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := '';
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := '';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := c1rec.actual_bod;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := c1rec.actual_eod;
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN
 select initcap(a.name)
 into :schedules_blk.sponsor_name
 from sponsors a, drive_sponsors b
 where b.drive_id = :schedules_blk.drive_id 
 and a.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id 
 and rownum=1;
 EXCEPTION 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 END;
 ELSE
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_bod := c1rec.actual_bod;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.actual_eod := c1rec.actual_eod;
 END IF;

 :schedules_blk.hours := round((:schedules_blk.actual_eod - :schedules_blk.actual_bod)*24*60);
 :schedules_blk.hours := lpad(trunc(:schedules_blk.hours/60),2,'0')||':'||lpad(mod(:schedules_blk.hours,60),2,'0');

 found := 'Y';
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP; --End LOOP for DRIVES on particular date

 IF found = 'N' THEN
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.drive_date := d_date;
 :SCHEDULES_BLK.week_day := to_char(d_date,'Dy');
 
 BEGIN
/**
 SELECT reason 
 INTO :schedules_blk.drive_id
 FROM STAFF_OFF_DAY
 WHERE unavail_date = d_date
 AND staff_no = :control_blk.staff_no ;
 EXCEPTION when no_data_found then
**/
 :schedules_blk.drive_id := 'Not Assigned'; 
 END;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 d_date := d_date + 1 ;

 END;
 END IF;
END LOOP; ---End LOOP for dates between from date AND to date

first_record;
don_mcal_common.staff_weekly_hours(:control_blk.schedule_id,:control_blk.staff_no,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :control_blk.tot_work_hrs );
select count(*) into work_assgn_cnt 
 from staff_off_day
 where staff_no= :control_blk.staff_no
 and assignment_type='WORK' 
 and unavail_date between to_date(:control_blk.from_date,'mm-dd-rr')
 and to_date(:control_blk.to_date,'mm-dd-rr') 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and rownum =1;
 if(work_assgn_cnt=1) then
 go_block('staff_off_day'); 
 execute_query; 
 :ow_d_hours := num_to_hrs(nvl(:ow_hours,0));
 end if;

 select count(*) into nonwork_assgn_cnt
 from staff_off_day
 where staff_no= :control_blk.staff_no
 and assignment_type='NWORK'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and unavail_date between to_date(:control_blk.from_date,'mm-dd-rr')
 and to_date(:control_blk.to_date,'mm-dd-rr') 
 and rownum =1;
 if (nonwork_assgn_cnt=1) then
 go_block('non_job_blk');
 execute_query;
 :nw_d_hours := num_to_hrs(nvl(:nw_hours,0));
 end if;
 v_tot_disp_hrs := (substr(:control_blk.tot_work_hrs,1, instr(:control_blk.tot_work_hrs, ':')-1)) *60 + 
 substr(:control_blk.tot_work_hrs, instr(:control_blk.tot_work_hrs, ':')+1);
 v_tot_non_work := (substr(:ow_d_hours ,1, instr(:ow_d_hours , ':')-1)) *60 + 
 substr(:ow_d_hours , instr(:ow_d_hours , ':')+1);
 v_diff := v_tot_disp_hrs - nvl(v_tot_non_work,0);
 :control_blk.disp_tot_hrs := to_char(trunc(v_diff/60))
 ||':'||
 lpad(
 to_char(
 mod(v_diff,60)
 )
 ,2,'0');

 item_change('control_blk.staff_no','D');
 item_change('control_blk.schedule_id','D');
 set_item_property('control_blk.schedule_id_lov_but',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('control_blk.staff_no_lov_but',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('control_blk.retrieve',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('schedules_blk.disp_hours',UPDATEABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 clear_message;
 go_block('schedules_blk');
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALC_START_END
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE calc_start_end(p_start in out date,
 p_end in out date,
 p_jobcd in varchar2)
IS
 start_minus number(4) := 0;
 end_add number(4) := 0;
 v_date date;
BEGIN
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 IF p_start is null or p_end is null or p_jobcd is null THEN
 return;
 END IF;
 BEGIN
 SELECT nvl(sort_sequence_2,0), nvl(sort_sequence_3,0) 
 INTO start_minus, end_add
 FROM valid_master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY'
 AND code = p_jobcd
 AND v_date between eff_date 
 and nvl(term_date,v_date);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 -- Assumption here is that the sort sequences fetched 
 -- are always in minutes.
 p_start := p_start - (start_minus/(24*60));
 p_end := p_end + (end_add/(24*60));
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_PIGGY_DRIVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_piggy_drive (x_drive_id varchar2, 
 x_piggy_flg out VARCHAR2,
 h_piggy_start_time out date,
 h_piggy_end_time out date)IS
begin
declare
 piggy_drive_id drive_groups.drive_id%type;
BEGIN
 x_piggy_flg := 'Y';
 begin
 select a.drive_id
 into piggy_drive_id 
 from drive_groups a, drives b
 where drive_group_type='PIGGY' 
 and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and drive_group_id = (
 select drive_group_id 
 from drive_groups
 where drive_id = x_drive_id)
 and a.drive_id != x_drive_id 
 and a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 x_piggy_flg := 'N';
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 end;
 if (x_piggy_flg = 'Y') then
 BEGIN
 SELECT ssd.actual_bod, ssd.actual_eod
 INTO h_piggy_start_time, h_piggy_end_time
 from staff_schedule_details ssd
 where ssd.staff_no = :control_blk.staff_no 
 and ssd.schedule_id = :control_blk.schedule_id 
 and ssd.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and ssd.drive_id = piggy_drive_id ;
 EXCEPTION when no_data_found THEN
 h_piggy_start_time := NULL;

ProgramUnit.Name: NUM_TO_HRS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--Assumption : p_numb is always in minutes
FUNCTION NUM_TO_HRS (p_numb in number) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 temp_ret_var varchar2(8);
 temp_numb number(6);
BEGIN
 temp_ret_var := to_char(trunc(p_numb/60));
 temp_numb := mod(p_numb,60);
 temp_ret_var := temp_ret_var || ':' 
 || lpad(to_char(temp_numb),2,'0');
 IF temp_ret_var = ':' THEN
 temp_ret_var := null;
 END IF;
 return temp_ret_var;
END;

Trigger.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare /** populating drive details for the staff no **/
query_count number := 0;
h_drive_id drives.drive_id%type;
h_drive_date drives.drive_date%type;
h_job_cd staff_schedule_details.job_code%type;
h_driver_type staff_schedule_details.special_job_code%type;
no_days number;
x_date drives.drive_date%type;
loop_cnt number :=7;
total_hours number;
work_assgn_cnt number := 0;
start_time date;
end_time date;
mins number;
hrs number;
cursor cur1 is 

 select a.drive_id ,a.drive_date ,
 b.job_code ,b.special_job_code 
 from drives a, staff_schedule_details b
 where b.staff_no = :control_blk.staff_no and
 b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 b.schedule_id = :control_blk.schedule_id and
 a.drive_id = b.drive_id and
 a.chapter_id = b.chapter_id 
 order by a.drive_date asc ;
 
begin
 go_block('staff_off_day');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 go_block('non_job_blk');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 go_block('schedules_blk');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 hide_view('CAN02');
 x_date := to_date(:control_blk.from_date,'mm-dd-rr');
 total_hours := 0;
 open cur1;
 loop
 
 fetch cur1 into h_drive_id,
 h_drive_date,
 h_job_cd,
 h_driver_type;
 no_days := h_drive_date - x_date;
 
 for z in 1 .. loop_cnt
 loop
 if (trunc(h_drive_date) = trunc(x_date)) then
 exit;
 else
 :schedules_blk.drive_date := x_date;
 :schedules_blk.drive_id := 'Not Assigned';
 select to_char(:schedules_blk.drive_date,'DY') into
 :schedules_blk.week_day from dual;
 loop_cnt := loop_cnt - 1;
 if(loop_cnt > 0) then
 next_record;
 x_date := x_date +1;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 
 if(loop_cnt > 0 ) then
 :schedules_blk.drive_date := h_drive_date;
 select to_char(:schedules_blk.drive_date,'DY') into
 :schedules_blk.week_day from dual;
 :schedules_blk.drive_id := h_drive_id;
 calc_drive_sch_times(h_drive_id,start_time,end_time,:global.chapter_id);
 mins := trunc(10*((to_number(to_char(end_time,'MI'))/60) -(to_number(to_char(start_time,'MI'))/60))); 
 if mins < 0 then
 hrs := to_number(to_char(end_time,'HH24'))-to_number(to_char(start_time,'HH24'))-1;
 elsif (mins > 0 OR mins = 0)then
 hrs := to_number(to_char(end_time,'HH24'))-to_number(to_char(start_time,'HH24'));
 end if;
 :schedules_blk.hours := to_char(hrs)||'.'||to_char(abs(mins));
 --:schedules_blk.hours := to_char(to_number(to_char(end_time,'HH24.MI')) - to_number(to_char(start_time,'HH24.MI')),'90.90');
 total_hours := total_hours + to_number(:schedules_blk.hours);
 :schedules_blk.timing := to_char(start_time,'HH24:MI')||' - '||to_char(end_time,'HH24:MI');
 :schedules_blk.job_cd := h_job_cd;
 if (h_driver_type = 'VDRVR') then
 :schedules_blk.driver_typ := 'Van';
 elsif (h_driver_type = 'CDRVR') then
 :schedules_blk.driver_typ := 'Coach';
 end if;
 x_date := x_date + 1;
 loop_cnt := loop_cnt -1; 
 :schedules_blk.week_day := substr(to_char(:schedules_blk.drive_date,'DAY'),1,3); 
 /** selects sponsor name for a drive id **/
 begin
 select a.name into :schedules_blk.sponsor_name
 from sponsors a,drive_sponsors b
 where b.drive_id = :schedules_blk.drive_id and
 a.sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id;

 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 next_record;
 end if;
 if cur1%NOTFOUND then
 exit;
 end if;
 
 end loop; 
close cur1; 
:control_blk.tot_hrs := to_char(total_hours); 
first_record; 
select count(*) into work_assgn_cnt from staff_off_day
 where staff_no= :control_blk.staff_no and
 assignment_type='WORK' and
 rownum =1;

if(work_assgn_cnt=1) then
 go_block('staff_off_day'); 
 execute_query; 
end if;
end;
